_comment: Non-sensitive defaults only. Override secrets via environment variables: Discord__Token, ConnectionStrings__Npgsql (see fishmmo-secrets.env or fish shell snippet).

Discord._comment_token: Token MUST be set via environment variable Discord__Token at runtime. An empty token causes the bot to fail at startup. Never commit the token to source control.
Discord._comment_guild_id: 0 means disabled. Set to a real Discord guild ID (snowflake) for the bot to operate in a specific server.

_comment2: ChatPollingIntervalSeconds polls the SQL database for new messages. Set to 5 for development to reduce database load; tune for production based on expected chat volume. Consider 1-2s for production.
_comment_chat_relay: ChatRelay.GameToDiscordChannels is an ALLOWLIST of in-game chat channels the bot may republish to Discord. Omit it to use the built-in default (Say, World, Trade, Region) — public channels only. Tell, Guild and Party are private and are refused even if named here; making them relayable is a code change, not a config change.
_comment_bridge_length: BridgeMessageMaxLength caps a Discord message bridged into the game. Keep it at or below the game's ChatBroadcast.MaxTextLength (128) — clients discard anything longer, so a larger value makes long messages vanish rather than arrive truncated.
